2117281330505609495.content_en:
I have time at the airport, so now that it's November I summarized my results so far.

① Vantage account

Initial capital: 1,000,000 yen. I returned 3,000,000 yen from profits partway through, but zero additional personal funds.
Total withdrawals: about 59.58 million yen (of which 3 million yen was re-deposited)
Realized profit: about +56.03 million yen
Unrealized profit: about +8.01 million yen

② FXGT account (this time's $10,000 account)

Realized profit: about +2.69 million yen ($17,001)
Unrealized profit: about +10.67 million yen ($67,537)

③ NIL

Stop-loss: about −4.14 million yen (cumulative P/L −26,221 USDT)

Total as of November 2

The 2 FX accounts: realized profit +58.72 million yen, unrealized profit +18.68 million yen
FX alone, including unrealized profit: +77.40 million yen
Subtracting the NIL loss as well,

on a realized basis +54.58 million yen
including unrealized profit +73.25 million yen

There are 2 months left this year. If BTC falls one more step, FX alone could see 100 million yen within the year. Buy gold, or keep shorting BTC as is.

空港でまだ時間があるから、11月に入ったところでここまでの収支をまとめてみた。

元手：100万円。途中で利益から300万円を戻したけど、追加の自己資金はゼロ。

確定益：＋約269万円（17,001ドル）
含み益：＋約1,067万円（67,537ドル）

③ NIL

損切り：−約414万円（累積損益 −26,221 USDT）

11月2日時点の合計

FXの2口座：確定益＋約5,872万円、含み益＋約1,868万円
FXだけなら、含み益込みで＋約7,740万円
NILの損も引くと、

確定ベースで＋約5,458万円

今年もあと2ヶ月。BTCがもう一段下げれば、FXだけで年内1億も見えてくるな。ゴールドを買うか、このままBTCショートでいくか。
